detail.longDescription: I find myself in need of a list of empirically appearing # masculinities . I mean the varieties of # masculinity actually shown by men (ideally contemporary North American men). My literature searches are giving me multiple theoretical perspectives, but I am hoping someone has done grounded theory on a bunch of interview responses or latent profile analysis on a range of survey results, etc. If anyone has pointers, I'm open to all of them. # research # psychology # sociology # anthropology
